title: unified rollouts: observability and stability enhancements for canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Production rollouts have experienced intermittent noisy rollbacks and poor visibility into why auto-rollback triggers fired for canary/AB/shadow traffic. Motivation: reduce false-positive rollbacks, make rollback reasoning auditable, and add metrics/tracing so oncall can triage faster. This PR bundles three areas: 1) observability: adds per-rollout metric labels, histogram buckets for latency regressions, and structured rollback reason payloads emitted to tracing; 2) stability guards: quorum and smoothing logic for composite metrics (error-rate + latency + degradation score) to avoid flapping; 3) tests & tooling: e2e stability harness for staged shadow probing, and a rollout simulator used in CI to catch logic regressions. Changes in this PR are intentionally conservative: default thresholds unchanged, new guards are opt-in via rollout policy flags. Rollout plan: merge to main, run canary on internal staging for 48h (automated), then gradually enable for select customers. Backout: feature flag to disable new guards and immediate metric-only mode if production anomalies are observed. Checklist: - [x] Metric labels and Dashboards added - [x] Traces emit rollback.reason structured payload - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] e2e stability harness in perf-canary job - [x] Docs for rollout policy flags
commits: feat(rollouts): emit structured rollback.reason in trace events
feat(observability): add rollout.label and metric buckets for rollout_latency_ms
feat(autorollback): quorum-based composite metric aggregator and smoothing buffer
test(e2e): add staged-shadow stability harness and simulator
docs: rollout policy flags and observability guide
review_comments: Carlos Mendes: LGTM overall. Two suggestions: add a toggle to avoid extra cardinality for rollout_label on high-throughput tenants; ensure histogram buckets include long-tail latency (Aisha: added opt-in label and expanded buckets in emitters.py).

Emily Zhao: Can we add an e2e that reproduces a noisy metric stream? The staged shadow simulator looks good but add a case for intermittent spikes (Aisha: added intermittent_spike scenario and CI job to run it nightly).

Ravi Kapoor: make sure metric smoothing doesn't delay real regressions past SLOs — please document worst-case detection delay (Aisha: documented worst-case delay and left thresholds conservative by default).
QA (internal): Found flake in test_quorum_aggregator under heavy load, added deterministic seeding to fix it (Aisha: fixed and pushed).
release_notes: Improved rollout observability and stability: structured rollback reason trace payloads, labeled rollout metrics, quorum-based composite metric smoothing to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks, staged-shadow e2e harness. Opt-in policy flags included; no default behavior changes.
